text: Hugh Hefner's widow fighting to keep explicit scrapbooks private | Jesse Weber LiveGloria Allred, the attorney for Hugh Hefner's widow, Crystal, joins NewsNation to discuss her attempts to keep private and intimate images in Hugh Hefner's scrapbooks from being digitized and publicized. "Jesse Weber Live" brings a fresh, fast-paced, and often unexpected take on the day’s headlines, diving into the biggest stories through the lens of legal expertise. Weeknights at 11p/10C.
